recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the seed issue's active-source application without taking on the separate FHIR-49839 action-element tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-49838 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by the CDS work group and requested updating the PlanDefinition resource description to support the PQ/CMC drug manufacturing use case by adding drug manufacturing process to the list of examples.
initial_application: Commit 4e5e893c4f, merged through HL7/fhir#3864 in 31c3058e64, updated the StructureDefinition.description metadata text, but left the root PlanDefinition differential element definition with the old text that ended at drug quality specifications.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and marked approved. CDS Confluence pages for 2025-03-19 and 2025-03-26 record the PQ/CMC discussion and approval to apply FHIR-49838 with companion tracker FHIR-49839. No directly relevant Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml at the root PlanDefinition element definition so both the resource metadata description and generated conformance definition include drug manufacturing process.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml: aligned the root PlanDefinition element definition with the approved resource description wording.
